connections.why: Membrane structure determines which substances cross and how
Enzymes catalyse the metabolic reactions of respiration and digestion
Cells must copy their structures faithfully before dividing by mitosis
Stem cells divide by mitosis to produce specialised cells
Meiosis and sexual reproduction generate genetic variation
Alleles of genes coded in DNA are what get inherited
Heritable variation is the raw material natural selection acts on
Evolutionary relationships underpin how organisms are classified
Transpiration and translocation move water in and sugars out of the leaf
Photosynthesis fixes the energy that flows through food webs
Insulin and glucagon are the hormones controlling blood sugar
Hormones such as ADH drive water and temperature regulation
Alveoli are exchange surfaces adapted by a large surface area : volume ratio
Blood transports the oxygen and glucose that respiration needs
The immune response is the body's reaction to invading pathogens
Vaccines and antibiotics are different medical responses to disease
Decomposers recycle nutrients through the carbon and nitrogen cycles
Human activity disrupts the interdependence that sustains biodiversity
